rows.title: Service WVTR
rows.finding: No installed laminate rate at48.79C, cyclic cold/heat and service water pressure is measured. Twofold rate defeats the R10 seven-day SiOx/3A closure.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure WVTR of the final aged, strained and seamed stack across actual T/RH; target<=0.08551g/m2/day for7days or<=0.01614 for30days in the stated R10 mass account.

rows.title: Flex, creases and defects
rows.finding: Flat coupon values do not include deployment folds, abrasion, crease pinholes or square-kilometre-equivalent defect statistics.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure leak and WVTR after representative forming, flex, handling, UV and abrasion; include seams and penetrations.

rows.title: Carrier and coating weights
rows.finding: ALD paper omits PET gauge; R10 ML3 zero-payload carrier limit is28.07um. SiOx/Verreal coat2g/m2 and foil adhesive3g/m2 are allowances.
rows.proposed_fix: Weigh the complete final laminate including all carrier, coatings, primer, adhesive and opacity layers. Do not use the12um recipe as a sourced product.

rows.title: ALD evidence floor and aging
rows.finding: Claimed sub1e-5 performance is below the stated5e-5 instrument sensitivity; oxide durability and PET transfer are unqualified.
rows.proposed_fix: Confirm detection limit, reporting bounds, long-term oxide protection and flex performance on the final carrier.

rows.title: Light and thermal protection
rows.finding: Added Al opacity and inherited white/attachment package are not verified OD4 or actual optical/thermal properties for new laminates.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure spectral transmission, aged absorptivity/emissivity and adhesion of the complete package.

rows.title: Whole-hull leakage and dry gas
rows.finding: Inherited seam/node/port leaks and dry-species permeability are assumptions. Dry ingress limits nominal ultrabarrier intervals.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure full pressure-rise/species curves and actual leak rates; resolve all pressure-normalised permeability units.

rows.title: Adsorbent equilibrium transfer
rows.finding: 6wt%working screen applies to the source3A isotherm,1wt%initial moisture and333K maximum bed temperature. Vendor/cation variation and contamination are unknown.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure actual batch isotherm and cyclic working capacity at10–33Pa with the relevant temperatures and co-adsorbates.

rows.title: Adsorption transport and heat rejection
rows.finding: R10 seven-day SiOx system requires about277m3/h effective water conductance and16.54W peak heat rejection.5kg distribution/monitoring plus25%housing are unverified.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate distributed access, dust retention, thermal coupling and bed temperature without unpriced fans or pumps; weigh functional hardware.

rows.title: Conditioning and regeneration
rows.finding: Initial90%conditioning and1day release time constant are inherited proxies. Ground350C regeneration energy assumes cp1kJ/kg/K and2xloss factor.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure drydown, repeat-cycle residual moisture, vacuum pumping work, cooldown and handling. Regenerate outside the PBO enclosure.

rows.title: Power and spare-mass fragility
rows.finding: R10 seven-day screen has1.12kgpayload.5W monitoring instead of0.5W makes it negative; additional transport hardware could erase it.
rows.proposed_fix: Build an actual electrical/installation bill and mission duty cycle, including sensors, batteries, mounts, thermal parts and contingency.

rows.title: PBO humidity-dose criterion
rows.finding: 5%of cold saturation is an inference from dry protected-yarn evidence, not a demonstrated long-term loaded-laminate safe boundary.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure loaded PBO/resin/interface strength retention under the full coupled moisture, temperature and light history.

rows.title: Aramid installed strength
rows.finding: 3GPa is conditioned yarn;95%retention,100%film efficiency and inherited thermal factor are optimistic assumptions.60%efficiency loses most favourable-weather closure.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure balanced membrane strength, creep, thermal mismatch, seams and long-term humid-service retention.

rows.title: UHMWPE creep
rows.finding: SK99/DM20 exceed1%creep over30days at900MPa/30C; thin strength-sized films are more highly stressed and warmer.
rows.proposed_fix: Obtain stress/temperature/time creep and rupture data for actual laminate; do not apply a single900MPa rate to higher stresses.

rows.title: M5 and LCP evidence gaps
rows.finding: No qualified M5/PIPD humid-service membrane allowable found. Accessible LCP chart is relative, not absolute WVTR.
rows.proposed_fix: Obtain absolute gauge/rate/condition/areal-mass records for LCP and relevant loaded wet-strength data for M5 before numeric credit.

rows.title: 052 structural and weather assumptions
rows.finding: All favourable-member, nonlinear-shell, joint, film, water, mooring and weather limitations from052 remain open. Both-weather closes nowhere here.
rows.proposed_fix: Carry forward052NFI without dilution; confirm the entire actual structure and environmental loading.

rows.title: Local installation and free volume
rows.finding: Bed/housing volume is included but distribution stiffness, load introduction, detailed barrier solid volume and microlocal humidity are not resolved.
rows.proposed_fix: Integrate and test local mounts, thermal paths and humidity gradients; rerun structural/displacement accounting for final geometry.
